svg.title: STEMMate A3 prototype v1.1 - annotated user flow (WF1, WF2, WF3)

g.text: STEMMate A3 prototype v1.1 - annotated user flow (WF1, WF2, WF3)
wrong PIN -> text error, 5 tries -> 30 s pause
S01 Sign in on shared device
S02 Home (status: Online / Offline shown as icon + text)
WF1 Find and save an activity offline (FR-01, FR-02)
so a missing activity cannot be selected
(size shown before download, image + text alternative)
WF2 Build a session plan offline (FR-03, FR-04, PR-01)
S06 Plan editor pre-filled from saved activity
steps + minutes, materials checklist, safety, inclusion, learner count
changes kept on screen + Retry saving draft
"Draft saved on this device at hh:mm"
Select "Mark ready and queue for sync"
links to each field, inline messages
WF3 Sync, failure and recovery (FR-05, QR-02)
S07c "Upload failed: safe on this device"
auto retry after 20 s, max 5, Retry now
S08b error "Choose a version for each difference"
Merged plan saved on device FIRST, then uploaded
S10 Sign out and lock (another profile cannot see plans)
